تستصبحن (form X)
# تَسْتَصْبِحْنَ (tastaṣbiḥna) /tas.tasˤ.biħ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
# تُسْتَصْبَحْنَ (tustaṣbaḥna) /tus.tasˤ.baħ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
